top_signals.title: Germany, Poland tap SATIM to analyze military satellite imagery
top_signals.summary: SATIM, a Polish maker of AI-based analysis tools for synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery, has obtained a contract from Poland’s military to supply software for the automated analysis of satellite imagery.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
